about: Immersion Life is AFK Realm's continuation of vrzgames/mod-playerbots-city-life (created by iCore). It fills cities, towns and PvP locations with configurable playerbots. Its SQL files under data/sql/manual must be applied to the world and characters databases before the first start; AFK Realm shows the module's options in the server settings.

patches.name: Bots walk in towns and houses
patches.why: AiPlayerbot.RandombotsWalkingRPG is documented as walking anywhere but only walked indoors, and AiPlayerbot.RandombotsWalkingRPG.InDoors was loaded but unused. The patch gives both switches their documented meaning.

settings.why: City and house bots should walk like people, not sprint through the streets.
Keep the indoor walking switch on as well; it is harmless when walking anywhere is on and remains useful when the first switch is turned off.
